bullets.text: Streamlined Container Management - **Copilot** integrates with **VS Code** for easier container management through conversational commands.
Smart Holiday Shopping - **Copilot** in **Edge** enhances shopping with features like cashback and price tracking.
Xbox Gaming Experience - **Windows 11** handhelds now support a full screen **Xbox** gaming experience for seamless play.
Web Install API Testing - The **Web Install API** is ready for testing, allowing easier web app installations via **Microsoft Edge**.
AI in Security Operations - **Microsoft Defender Experts** leverage AI to enhance SOC efficiency and redefine analyst roles.
